{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with highest sample_seq for each patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Confirm: now we have one row per patient
print(f"After deduplication: {len(df_dedup)} unique patients")
print(f"Expected: 800 - 48 = 752")

# Check the distribution of severity
severity_counts = df_dedup['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)
print(severity_counts)"}
